description.value: Fiamo is an Italian kitchen, pizza, and wine bar in downtown Victoria occupying a warm, European-bistro-style space with exposed brick walls adorned with authentic Italian racing bikes and a centrepiece chandelier. The menu leans traditional Italian with Mediterranean, French, and Spanish influences, featuring wood-fired pizzas, house-made pasta, and a broad international wine list. A heated patio, a mezzanine for private gatherings of up to 18, and a late-night pizza service make it a versatile stop on the Yates Street corridor.

The menu clearly shows multiple vegetarian dishes (Verdure pizza, Margherita, Caprese, Brussels Sprouts, Barbabietole salad) as positive evidence for that amenity.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (250-388-5824) sourced from website only.
Website still displays a stale closure notice for February 28 / March 1 (past dates as of current date), suggesting the site is not always kept current — monitor for accuracy.
A June 18 staff-party closure notice appears on the site; this is a one-off temporary closure, not a concern for the listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service Italian restaurant in downtown Victoria with a confirmed website, phone, and current menu. A useful evening dining and late-night stop for touring cyclists.
